name: herdkit-coordinator
description: Thin wrapper that launches the herdkit coordinator inside Codex. The herdkit CLI (bin/herd) stays the source of truth: on invocation this plugin renders and hands off to the CLI-generated coordinator skill rather than duplicating any coordinator logic.

interface.longDescription: Packaging layer that exposes the herdkit coordinator to Codex. It ships no coordinator logic of its own: on invocation it verifies the herdkit CLI, runs `herd render`, and hands off to the CLI-rendered .agents/skills/herd-coordinator/SKILL.md, so the CLI and its templates stay the single source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Start the herdkit coordinator for this project
Show the herdkit backlog and pick the next item
Spawn a builder for the next backlog item
